summary.text: Justin Brown, a Republican, represents Missouri Senate District 16, which includes Dent, Laclede, Maries, Phelps, Pulaski and Wright counties; he was elected in 2018.
He chairs the Senate Emerging Issues and Professional Registration Committee.

paragraphs.text: Brown is a native of Phelps County and graduated from the University of Missouri-Rolla (now Missouri University of Science and Technology) with a degree in history.
He worked as a commercial loan officer specializing in agricultural financing while owning and operating a family farm.
He farms more than 2,200 acres, primarily corn and soybeans, and keeps a cow-calf operation.
He has served on the boards of the Missouri Beef Council, the Phelps County Farm Bureau and his local MFA Cooperative.
Brown lives in Rolla, attends St. Patrick Catholic Church, and is the father of three children.
